ucs.title: [LLM] Black Basta ransomware deployment via PsExec + ADMIN$ share fan-out with .basta extension
ucs.description: Hunts Black Basta's signature endgame: an operator stages the encryptor on a beachhead, copies it to ADMIN$/C$ on multiple internal hosts, and detonates via PsExec / remote service creation — followed by mass file renames to .basta. This chain (T1021.002 → T1569.002 → T1486) is the crew's documented deployment pattern across the 2023-2024 campaigns (CISA AA24-131A).
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=PsExec.exe OR Processes.process_name=PsExec64.exe OR Processes.process_name=paexec.exe OR Processes.original_file_name=PsExec.c) (Processes.process="*-s*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*\\admin$*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*\\c$*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as src | join type=inner src [| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count values(Filesystem.file_name) as encrypted_files values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths dc(Filesystem.dest) as targets_hit from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.basta" OR Filesystem.file_name="readme.txt" OR Filesystem.file_name="instructions_read_me.txt") by Filesystem.dest _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | rename dest as src] | where targets_hit>=3 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let PsExecBeachhead = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName has_any ("psexec.exe","psexec64.exe","paexec.exe")
   or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "psexec.c"
   or InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "psexec.c"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\\admin$", @"\\c$", "-s ", "-accepteula")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project BeachheadTime = Timestamp, BeachheadDevice = DeviceName, AccountName,
          PsExecCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let BastaEncryption = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName endswith ".basta"
    or FileName in~ ("instructions_read_me.txt","readme.txt")
| summarize EncryptionTime = min(Timestamp),
            EncryptedFileCount = dcount(FolderPath),
            VictimHosts = dcount(DeviceName),
            SampleVictims = make_set(DeviceName, 5)
            by InitiatingProcessAccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where EncryptedFileCount >= 25;        // 25 = empirical floor; Black Basta drops thousands
PsExecBeachhead
| join kind=inner BastaEncryption on $left.AccountName == $right.InitiatingProcessAccountName
| where EncryptionTime between (BeachheadTime .. BeachheadTime + 4h)
| project BeachheadTime, BeachheadDevice, AccountName, PsExecCmd,
          EncryptionTime, EncryptedFileCount, VictimHosts, SampleVictims
| order by BeachheadTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 30m;
let PsExecBeachhead = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("psexec.exe","psexec64.exe","paexec.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (@"\admin$", @"\c$", "-s ", "-accepteula")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project BeachheadTime = TimeGenerated, BeachheadHost = Computer,
          Account = SubjectUserName, PsExecCmd = CommandLine;
let BastaEncryption = ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where TargetFileName endswith ".basta"
    or TargetFileName in~ ("instructions_read_me.txt","readme.txt")
| summarize EncryptionTime = min(TimeGenerated),
            EncryptedFileCount = dcount(TargetFilePath),
            VictimHosts = dcount(DvcHostname),
            SampleVictims = make_set(DvcHostname, 5)
            by ActorUsername, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where EncryptedFileCount >= 25;
PsExecBeachhead
| join kind=inner BastaEncryption on $left.Account == $right.ActorUsername
| where EncryptionTime between (BeachheadTime .. BeachheadTime + 4h)
| project BeachheadTime, BeachheadHost, Account, PsExecCmd,
          EncryptionTime, EncryptedFileCount, VictimHosts, SampleVictims
| order by BeachheadTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\PsExec.exe OR *\psexec.exe OR *\PSEXEC.EXE OR *\PsExec64.exe OR *\psexec64.exe OR *\paexec.exe OR *\PAExec.exe) @CommandLine:(*\\admin$* OR *\\ADMIN$* OR *\\c$* OR *\\C$* OR *-accepteula*)) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @TargetFilename:(*.basta OR *\instructions_read_me.txt OR *\readme.txt))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(psexec(64)?|paexec)\.exe$/i OR FileVersionOriginalFileName=/psexec\.c/i
| regex("(\\\\admin\\$|\\\\c\\$|-accepteula|-s\\s)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten
  | regex("(\\.basta$|instructions_read_me\\.txt$|readme\\.txt$)", field=TargetFileName, flags=i)
  | groupBy([aid, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(as=victim_files), min(_time, as=enc_start)])
  | victim_files >= 25}, field=aid)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, enc_start, victim_files], function=count())
| sort(enc_start, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Bare PsExec activity is noisy (legit admins use it); bare ransom-extension file writes lag the kill chain. Black Basta uniquely chains them: an interactive (non-machine) account spawns PsExec against ADMIN$/C$, then within hours the same account writes >=25 .basta files alongside the crew's signature instructions_read_me.txt note across multiple hosts. ucs.title: [LLM] Black Basta LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump pre-lateral movement
ucs.description: Black Basta operators consistently dump LSASS through the LOLBin chain `rundll32 comsvcs.dll, MiniDump <lsass-pid> <path> full` before pivoting via SMB/PsExec. This catches that exact technique (T1003.001 via signed-binary proxy) which the crew prefers over Mimikatz because comsvcs.dll is signed by Microsoft and bypasses many AV signatures.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as full_cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=rundll32.exe (Processes.process="*comsvcs*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*#24*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll*,MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll,#24*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump", "#24", ", 24", ",24")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend DumpPath = extract(@"(?i)comsvcs(?:\.dll)?\s*[,#]\s*(?:MiniDump|#?24)\s+\d+\s+([^\s]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          InitiatingProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine, DumpPath, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith @"\rundll32.exe"
| where CommandLine has "comsvcs"
| where CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump", "#24", ", 24", ",24")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend DumpPath = extract(@"(?i)comsvcs(?:\.dll)?\s*[,#]\s*(?:MiniDump|#?24)\s+\d+\s+([^\s]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcess = ParentProcessName, CommandLine, DumpPath
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Black Basta LSASS Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
id: 1b8a8a4a-7c1f-4d8c-8f3a-bb0d2c5e9a01
status: experimental
description: Detects Black Basta's preferred LSASS dumping technique using rundll32 to call the MiniDump export of comsvcs.dll, a signed Microsoft binary.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-131a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/05/13
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.t1218.011
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains: 'comsvcs'
  selection_export:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'MiniDump'
      - '#24'
      - ',24'
      - ', 24'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and selection_export and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate forensic/IR tools dumping LSASS (rare; should be allowlisted by host)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE) @CommandLine:(*comsvcs* AND (*MiniDump* OR *minidump* OR *#24* OR *,24* OR *, 24*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i
| regex("comsvcs", field=CommandLine, flags=i)
| regex("(MiniDump|#24|,\\s?24)", field=CommandLine, flags=i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(), min(_time, as=first_seen)])
| sort(first_seen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The rundll32→comsvcs.dll→MiniDump chain is a narrow, intent-specific TTP — there is virtually no benign use of calling the MiniDump export with an LSASS PID. CISA's AA24-131A advisory and Mandiant UNC4393 tracking both call out Black Basta's preference for this LOLBin over Mimikatz to evade AV (comsvcs.dll is Microsoft-signed). Detecting it provides a high-fidelity choke point in their kill chain
